documents.title: delgado-settlement-agreement-executed.docx
documents.body:
EXECUTED SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT - DELGADO v. HALVORSEN MARKET GROUP, INC. (SIMULATED)
Delgado v. Halvorsen Market Group, Inc., No. 8:24-cv-03117 (M.D. Fla.) (SIMULATED)

Settlement fund: $42,500,000. Class period: 2019-03-01 through 2025-01-31. The Effective Date is stipulated as 2025-09-15.

Section 7.3 (Survey and Remediation). Within 60 days of the Effective Date, Halvorsen shall complete a pricing-law compliance survey covering all 50 states and the District of Columbia (51 jurisdictions) and adopt a remediation plan. Puerto Rico is expressly EXCLUDED from the survey and from every remediation count under this Agreement.

Section 7.4 (Receipt Disclosure). Every register receipt shall add the exact footer sentence: "If an item rings up higher than the lowest posted or advertised price, you are entitled to the lower price at the register."

Section 7.5 (Terms, Receipt Specification, Signage). Within 90 days of the Effective Date, Halvorsen shall (a) delete from its online Terms of Sale any term making the register price controlling, (b) insert a clause honoring "the lowest posted, advertised, or shelf price", (c) publish a weighted-goods receipt specification whose line format is "NET WT {weight} LB @ ${unit_price}/LB", and (d) post lowest-price signage in every store located in a statute jurisdiction.

Section 7.6 (Computation). Periods run in calendar days from (and excluding) the Effective Date. If a deadline falls on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday, it extends to the next business day.

documents.title: stipulated-final-judgment-CIVSB-2024-118822.docx
documents.body:
STIPULATED FINAL JUDGMENT - CIVSB-2024-118822 (SIMULATED)
People v. Halvorsen Market Group, Inc., San Bernal County Superior Court No. CIVSB-2024-118822 (SIMULATED).

Section 4.1. Quarterly price-verification audits at 25 designated stores; 100-item stratified sample per store.
Section 4.2. A store FAILS an audit only if it records MORE THAN 2 overcharges per 100 items (overcharge accuracy below 98%). Undercharges never fail a store; they count only toward the increased-inspection watch list, which lists every store whose TOTAL errors (overcharges plus undercharges) exceed 2.
Section 4.3. Each failing store incurs a $2,500 civil penalty and a mandatory re-audit within 30 days of the audit completion date.
Section 5.1. The customer guarantee text must read exactly: "If we charge more than the lowest posted or advertised price, you will receive $3.00 off the correct price. If the item costs $3.00 or less, it is free."
Section 6.2. The quarterly compliance report is due 30 days after quarter close.

tasks.prompt: Matter 200003. Remediate the PeakStream+ enrollment, renewal-email, and cancellation flows to the consent order. Read IN FULL: the FCB consent order, the current renewal email template, the current cancel-flow spec, the plan catalog, and the checkout screens. File a new MatterVault document named exactly 'peakstream-remediation-spec.docx' (folder_id 43, workspace_id 23, doc_class SPEC) that: places the disclosure box immediately adjacent to the enrollment button and promises members they can 'cancel anytime online'; rewrites the renewal email to include the exact phrase 'will automatically renew on', the annual price, and a cancellation link; and specifies a cancel flow reachable in no more than 2 clicks from the account page, with the control labeled exactly 'Cancel Subscription' and at most one retention offer. The 'call us to confirm' step must not survive into the spec.

args.body:
PEAKSTREAM+ ENROLLMENT, RENEWAL, AND CANCELLATION REMEDIATION SPEC (SIMULATED)

Checkout: the disclosure box sits immediately adjacent to the 'Start Membership' button, states the price, the renewal date, and that members can cancel anytime online.
Renewal email (annual plan): includes the phrase 'will automatically renew on' with the renewal date, states the $119.99 annual price, and carries a cancellation link.
Cancel flow: reachable in no more than 2 clicks from the account page; the control is labeled exactly 'Cancel Subscription'; at most one retention offer before cancellation completes; the phone-confirmation step is removed.

body.contains: no more than 2 clicks from the account page

tasks.prompt: Matter: Bluewater - AG CID / Fee Remediation (matter 200004). Produce the corrected-pricing exhibit and drip-pricing analysis. Read IN FULL: the AG civil investigative demand, the fee schedule, the pricing-law memo pack (federal and states), the UNRELIABLE junior-associate draft v0 (identify both of its errors), the booking screens, and the menu/folio samples. File a new MatterVault document named exactly 'bluewater-fee-remediation-exhibit.docx' (folder_id 44, workspace_id 24, doc_class REPORT) containing: the corrected first-screen ad string exactly '$228.95 per night (total before taxes)'; a line exactly 'three-night quote total before taxes: $NNN.NN' (3 nights of the all-in nightly price plus the per-stay processing fee); separate named checkout lines for the amenity and processing fees; the federal-rule status line exactly 'FEDERAL FEE RULE: IN EFFECT since 2025-05-12' with the per-violation penalty; the line 'bespoke all-in-pricing jurisdictions: 3'; and the restaurant service-charge disposition ('RETAINED with clear-and-conspicuous menu disclosure'). Calendar the CID response deadline (45 days from service) as kind 'deadline' with summary containing 'civil investigative demand'.

BLUEWATER FEE REMEDIATION EXHIBIT AND 51-JURISDICTION DRIP-PRICING MATRIX (SIMULATED)

FEDERAL FEE RULE: IN EFFECT since 2025-05-12; penalty exposure up to $51,744 per violation. (Distinct from the vacated subscription rule - the v0 draft's vacatur claim is wrong.)
bespoke all-in-pricing jurisdictions: 3 (CA-style eff 2024-07-01; MN-style eff 2025-01-01; MA-style eff 2025-09-02); all other 48 jurisdictions UDAP-only.

Corrected first-screen ad string (exact): $228.95 per night (total before taxes)
three-night quote total before taxes: $698.85
Checkout itemization (separate named lines, never a 'taxes & fees' lump): 'Amenity Fee $39.95/night' and 'Processing Fee $12.00'.
Occupancy tax 11.5%: government-imposed, excludable from the advertised total, disclosed before payment.
Restaurant service charge: RETAINED with clear-and-conspicuous menu disclosure (the restaurant exception permits it; the v0 recommendation to eliminate it is rejected).
